company_info.company_description: "Making clean energy personal.TTEC (Thoroughtec Solar and Electrical Pty Ltd) is a locally owned and operated, family-run company and a trusted provider of high-quality solar and electrical solutions, serving homes and businesses throughout South Australia for over 20 years.Specialising in solar panel installation, battery home storage systems, system maintenance, and electrical services, we are committed to helping customers lower energy costs, reduce environmental impact, and harness the power of renewable energy – future-proof your home or business from electricity price hikes with solar from TTEC!With a focus on excellence and customer satisfaction, TTEC delivers tailored solutions backed by long-term warranties and professional service. Our experienced energy consultant, Adrian, ensures an on-site energy assessment is completed to quote your solar system accurately and provides you with personalised options for consideration while adhering to your budget and requirements.Our in-house installers complete every installation to the highest standards, offering reliable and efficient solar systems designed to meet your unique energy needs.Whether you want to switch to solar, upgrade an existing system, or need expert advice, TTEC is your partner for sustainable energy solutions. Go solar and save!"

reviews.review_description: Thoroughtec undertook a solar panel system installation at my property a number of years ago. Solar Quotes put me in touch with Thoroughtec. They have returned and installed a dual Tesla battery/expansion pack system. Once again, from the start, the advice and consultation with Adrian was impressive. Tesla system at attractive competitive pricing. Punctual professional installation team who discussed the work before starting to ensure all aspects were understood. Cleaned up site and removed all packaging etc. Access to running system with logins etc before departure. Access to after sales support. Highly recommend to anyone considering solar and or battery systems

Adrian and the team were very responsive and accommodating. They did an excellent job at recommending the right system for my property and installation was efficient and professional. I would recommend to anyone looking for a great experience with their solar

I sent an initial email enquiry and received an automated response straight away, followed by a personal email the next day requesting some details for a rough quote. Adrian from Thoroughtec provided three clear options with approximate costs.The site visit was thorough and informative, all my questions were answered, and a quote was confirmed.Communication was excellent throughout, with regular check-ins and confirmation of dates and times.The team was always punctual, friendly, and professional — from the office staff to the onsite tradespeople. Installation was neat and tidy, the apps were set up and explained, and we were even offered the choice to keep or have the old equipment removed.A great experience all round. Highly recommend Adrian and the team at Thoroughtec Pty Ltd!
Came to quote and discuss options when a date and time confirmed.Installation excellent, installers very polite and didn't leave any rubbish.A full rundown on battery and how to use app.

My business PPH Electrical has relied on Adrian from Thoroughtec for years for our solar needs, always receiving excellent service. Adrian advised on a solar battery setup to offset high energy costs, proposing an ideal solution with a 4-5 year payback period. The work quality and communication were exceptional. It's a pleasure working with this fantastic local, family-owned business, and I will continue to recommend and collaborate with Thoroughtec.

Thoroughtec Pty Ltd is great at what they do. The installers were on-site on time and were courteous. They cleaned up after themselves, leaving not a trace they had been at my home. I was shown which App to download and then how to populate this as well. The owner called in to make sure I was happy with everything, which I was.The quote was a bit more than other quotes, but, I had used Thoroughtec for my panels, and I knew that I would be happy with the installation and any after questions.Could recommend them with my hand on my heart.

Adrian from Thoroughtec met me on-site to confirm the details and locations of the solar and battery and provided important feedback to assist the installation. His team arrived on the day scheduled and finished off the install in 1 day and left the site tidy. Very pleased with the whole process and Adrian even sent through some great drone photos from above. Was able to login to the Tesla app and view my system charging up with their help. Well done to Adrian and his team.RegardsDarren

You can't always believe everything you read online, but everything they say about TTEC is absolutely true! I did some 'research' and looked at their reviews - outstanding! I agree with the masses and highly recommend TTEC for an honest, authentic, high-quality experience.From initial engagement to final handover, every aspect felt in perfect control and was expertly communicated. All my questions (and there were a few) were answered promptly and with genuine care - "this is what I'd do if it were my place", giving me peace of mind and knowledge that I was making the right decisions.The team were punctual, polite, clean, and respectful. The work was completed efficiently and at an extremely high level; everything was neatly tucked away and looks seamless on the property.

My third time using Thoroughtec - this time to install my new home battery (previously installed solar and EV charger). Once again, a great job from their great team. These guys are organised, reliable, helpful and very professional - delivering excellent quality work and products. They were strongly recommended to me and in turn I can't recommend them highly enough.

Everything about this experience was painless and easy for us.  The Solar Quotes promise to put us in contact with three quality companies felt as though it had been met completely.  We would have happily given our business to any of them and, ultimately, chose the one whose product felt like the best fit for our budget and needs, but it was line ball.Thouroughtec quickly visited us, answered all of our questions (as well as alerting us to other points we'd have missed), gave a quick and clear quote, very promptly set and kept to a date for the installation (notwithstanding several very wet days beforehand that would have excused a delay), provided an extremely professional and friendly team of installers, were entirely willing to make late changes to the installation if we'd wanted any, and left a clean, neat space when they left. They also arranged with our energy retailer to have our meter upgraded to a smart meter and have offered to help us when we then move to using a VPP.  We could not have been happier.

We had a great experience with Thoroughtec Solar from start to finish.Sales & Quoting: Adrian made the quoting process really easy. He was clear, transparent, and took the time to answer all our questions without any pressure. He understood what we needed and tailored the system accordingly.Installation: The team arrived on time and worked efficiently. They were polite, respectful, and kept the site tidy throughout the process. Everything was completed as scheduled with no issues.Customer Service: After the installation, they helped us get the grid connection sorted and showed us how to monitor the system properly. Communication was great, and we always felt supported throughout the process.Highly recommend Thoroughtec Solar— they were professional, friendly, and delivered exactly what they promised.

Always great advice. Good price and excellent installation and service. After sales questions also very helpful. Prompt, polite installation technicians. Would not hesitate to recommend Thoroughtec for all your solar and battery needs.

From start to finish, the entire process was smooth and efficient. The team provided clear, consistent communication and regular updates, which made the experience stress-free and straightforward.Despite some unavoidable delays around installation timing (due to factors outside the installer’s control), they remained transparent and proactive, ensuring the system was installed to the highest standard.I would absolutely recommend them to anyone looking for a reliable and professional solar installer.

I am an electrician myself, so I was very specific about how I wanted the install to look and perform.The techs were very polite and did a very good job with the install.The system was different to the average install as I have two phases to the property. I had other quotes, and it was clear those salespeople were not technical as they didn't understand the best way to utilise the phases to my benefit. Adrian was across it and recommended a system that best suited the house's configuration electrically.
Quality product. Quality install. Expert advice on how to manage our power-use and monitor on the app! also installed within a week of enquiring! Highly recommend.

I recently had a solar system and battery installed by Thoroughtec Pty Ltd, and I couldn’t be happier with the result. From the first consultation to the final handover, their team was professional, responsive, and incredibly knowledgeable.The installation was completed on time and to a very high standard. The solar panels and battery system were integrated seamlessly, and everything was explained clearly. It’s been running flawlessly, and I’ve already seen a noticeable drop in my power bills — plus the peace of mind of having backup power available.What really stood out was the attention to detail and genuine care the team showed throughout the process. I highly recommend Thoroughtec Pty Ltd to anyone looking for a reliable and experienced solar and battery installer.
Smooth/efficient quoting processInstall was fantastic, organised everything, polite, tidy and punctualFull turnkey product/service, nothing extra required by us which was fantastic

These guys are top notch professionals! I'm super happy with the end product but everything else, from sales to communication, to installation, to after care, was smooth as. I was considering getting a few quotes from other parties but after being in contact with Adrian, I decided to go nowhere else. The tradies were friendly, skilled and quick and the installation looks fantastic. All hassles that you don't want to be dealing with (connection to the grid, communications with energy companies) were taken care of by the people in the office and they're a pleasure to work with. I would hire this company any day of the week to be honest, highly recommended!!

Great company to deal with, Adrian was more than helpful from the initial contact to installation. there was a delay from the first contact, which was down to me, but Adrian was still always available with answers to any questions.The install was smooth, fast, and efficient. Which also included the removal of my old system, and trying not to break any of the old terracotta tiles. We will be using the boys again to install the batteries once the rebate comes in.We have had 24 Aiko panels installed, which are working brilliantly, and a Sig energy inverter for future battery install. So a massive thank you to the whole team. and highly recommended   A+++

Even years after installing my solar system, Thoroughtech Solar continue to treat me like a valued client. When my system recently went down, they had it back up and running within 24 hours. Exceptional service and support. Thank you, Adrian and the Thorough Tech team!

Adrian's consultation was ace, explained everything in detail so we could make the best choice for our fit out. From there the quote was detailed and clear, administration made things incredibly easy to get going. Then on the day the install team went above and beyond with attention to detail.Top tier company with outstanding customer service. Highly recommend.
Very impressed with their professionalism attitude and efficiency.Couldn't recommend higher.

Thank you Adrian and team as the experience has been great and the installation was trouble free and easy … the follow up and checking in was very good as it show you and the team are  customer focus … we are loving the benefits of our new solar system.
Seamless from quote to installation. Great price and quality highly recommended

We had Adrian from Thoroughtec Solar come and look at our faulty Inverter and within the day he had it approved for replacement under warranty and the Inverter was replaced that same week. Great service, communication and turn around time. Highly recommend!
Whole process was prompt and organised staff were friendly and polite

From the initial engagement through to the final handover the team were professional, great communicators and all round trustworthy individuals.We highly recommend this company will have since referred several family members to them.

True professionals who have truly mastered their craft. Their attention to detail is outstanding, and they’re a pleasure to work with—such great humans too! Communication was seamless from start to finish, making the entire process effortless. Having worked with other solar installers in the past, I can confidently say these guys are a breath of fresh air—zero stress, just exceptional service. I’ll be commissioning them for another solar setup on a second property soon.

Thoroughtec installed my 15 kW solar system last year and recently a Powerwall 3. I'm more than happy with the whole package. The installation was done professionally and it looks very clean and tidy. Adrian has been great when I needed support or had a question and responded very quickly.

Installing solar with Throughtec has been a complete game changer for us!From the initial quotation, Adrian provided expert recommendations tailored to our needs. Their team handled the entire installation seamlessly, setting up both the solar panels and battery without any issues.With six people in the house, we used to pay around $700/month on electricity. Now, not only do we have zero electricity bills, but we’re also earning $900/month from our solar setup with Amber!Hands down, the best decision we’ve made.I highly recommend Adrian for his dedication and exceptional service!

It’s rare to find a company these days that goes above and beyond but we did; Thankyou THOROUGHTEC.Let’s not kid ourselves; QUALITY solar installations can be expensive and with the cost of living having gone through the roof, every dollar counts especially, for us retirees. We were nervous. Is the initial outlay worth it? Will it last? What about the disaster installations you sometimes hear about? We HAD to get ‘bang for buck’. So naturally wd completed our research thoroughly with the help of our daughter and knew, roughly, what we wanted.Enter THOROUGHTEC; a locally based family company with a hard earned reputation built on diligence, professionalism, customer service and proven record - just read all of the reviews as we did!  I’m not going over the top : seriously, read them.Our daughter was the THOROUGHTEC  ‘guinea pig’ getting a massive 48 panel installation. We did baulk at the initial outlay cost but once her system was installed and after getting her government rebate (based on how many panels you get which is stupid - but that’s another story), the system proved conclusively, through the iSolarCloud (SunGrow) application, that with her battery and the grid returns, she’d never have another electricity bill again.  We were still nervous but now convinced solar power was for us and that THOROUGHTEC was our company of choice.Our THOROUGHTEC experience started with Adrian, our Energy Consultant, who coordinates literally everything, making our solar adventure completely hassle free.   He explained the whole THOROUGHTEC solar system process using our former electricity as a guide to developing a tailor made system to suit our specific needs and usage patterns.Adrian then used a drone over our roof and took pictures so he could explain precisely where the panels would go and our final quote had them graphically pictured on our actual roof. There was no heavy sales pitch like we have experienced with other companies; just a factual rundown of the THOROUGHTEC Solar Grow system, our needs and the anticipated results.  We were encouraged by Adrian to think about it overnight as he imparted quite a lot of information but the way it was presented made it very easy for even us ‘technophobes’ to understand.  The next day we paid a deposit and we were off. Very exciting.We waited a few weeks before THOROUGHTEC called us to confirm suitable installation dates and times. The timing was all about us!The team arrived precisely on time with a site coordinator, Thomas, and away they went. They worked extremely hard over a two day period to finalise our installation. It was a completely worry free experience; exactly as former reviewers had said.All of the THOROUGHTEC crew, without exception, were extremely courteous, professional and diligent.  Extensive photos were taken pre and post installation so there’s no squabble about the condition of our tiled roof which was perfect. The site was always tidy and all rubbish removed including our old Solar system.Following the perfect installation (check my photos out but ignore the large galvanized gas pipe and white extension cord), we downloaded the iSolarGuard (Sun Grow) App and Thomas assisted us in setting up our own ‘Solar Plant’. The App is very user friendly and intuitive. Our 10KW SUNGROW system had our stackable batteries (we got 3 but you can stack up to 8 if needs be) at 100% within 2-3hours whilst also delivering free power to our house. We are now literally using cost free electricity to run our home. (PS we have 3 freezers at the moment).If you want a worry free installation, using quality materials, then we have no hesitation whatsoever in recommending THOROUGHTEC. They were simply a pleasure to work with.  They delivered precisely what we agreed upon in a professional manner. There were no hidden costs or any surprises.  Should anyone want to see our setup themselves, just ask Adrian to give us a call and we’re more than happy to show you.Thanks THOROUGHTEC.

I can’t recommend Thoroughtec Solar highly enough for their outstanding service in installing our solar power system. From start to finish, their team was the epitome of professionalism. They not only expertly managed the installation but also went above and beyond by coordinating the upgrade of our power meter, which was an unexpected but greatly appreciated touch. Every step of the process was seamless, with clear communication, attention to detail, and a true commitment to quality. It’s rare to find a company that consistently exceeds expectations like Thoroughtec Solar. If you’re considering solar energy, they are absolutely the team to trust!
A very professional job from initial presentation to implementation by Andre's team at Thoroughtec. Highly recommended.
Install very tidy and removal of old system, great team.

After using Thoroughtec to install my solar a year or two ago, I went to them to have an EV charger installed.Once again, it was a great job by their great team - all courteous, friendly and professional.These guys are great - organised, reliable, helpful and excellent quality!
Professional, punctual, efficient, informative service.Would recommend to other purchasers.

Thoroughtec were a very professional company to deal with.The whole process from quote to installation was very easy and the final install was very professional.The sales and install teams were very friendly, efficient and completed an excellent job.

Of all the quotes I received Adrian/Thoroughtec were the only ones to come onsite to provide a (ver competitive) quote.Great process, fantastic communication and very professional in every way!The install is for a new build (which has suffered multiple delays, none of which were Thoroughtec's issue) but we got there in the end!I can't speak more highly of Adrian and the Thoroughtec team!
Everything was absolutely perfect. From initial quote to execution of the work. The process was exactly how I wanted it to go.

Had a PV system and a Tesla Powerwall battery installed 4 years ago. Initially the sales company appeared to be doing a good job...took the money, took care of the paperwork and organised a contractor (Thoroughtec) to do the installation.Over the last 4 years there have been a few issues with the system and on every occasion the service from the sales company has been pitiful and Thoroughtec have stepped in and sorted out the issues at no cost to me.Would highly recommend Adrian and his guys for any PV/battery installation.

Everything you could have asked for! Fast quoting and competitive pricing. Adrian and his team were very professional, tidy and attention to detail is un-matched! They guided us through the whole process, making sure we knew each and every step. Through for timing of their arrival, the efficiency of the install, the inverter placement, the panels' location and the in-app monitoring. High recommended

I highly recommend. From the first phone call right through to the end product all we got was a hardworking team who cared about our experience. They went above and beyond what I expected. A very positive experience even after the product was installed.
Adrian and the team were amazing for us.We went to them with a $300 bill and he has manage to bring it under $50 bucks by adding more panels and monitoring the system.Would highly recommend again.

Wow, what a fantastic experience from the moment Adrian from Thoroughtec Solar returned my phone call seeking advice on problems with our then solar system through to the installation of our new system, Through every step of the process involving visiting our home, diagnosing our problems, quoting alternative system options, installing our chosen new system and giving advice on alternative energy providers, Adrian’s communication and customer service was first class.  The installation commenced on the promised date and the staff involved were professional, polite, friendly, efficient and best of all the site was fully cleaned up before they left. Post installation service has also been excellent. We would highly recommend Adrian and his team.
Adrian and his boys were very quick to have the job done. Very professional. Neat work. Very happy

The Thoroughtec Solar team provided a great service installing a PV and battery solution in our new house. Their quote was very competitive compared with 3 other suppliers. The location and installation of the 24 × 440W Jinko Solar Tiger Neo panels looks rock solid coupled with a Sungrow 3 Phase inverter and a Sungrow 9.6kWH battery. Final installation and setup was quick and the iSolarCloud app and website make it dead easy to understand what the system is doing. Even with a fairly low feed-in tariff I'm actually making money out of this system, at least in the cooler months. Overall highly recommend Thoroughtec Solar.
They sent videos of the install and gave a detailed run down on the system.Also quoting was super easy and gave me multiple options.Would use these guys over and over
Excellent customer service friendly and very helpful outstanding installation team very helpful in all aspects of the install great team of people highly recommend this company and it's people.

From the very start Adrian was always available to speak to me and answer any questions. He was very thorough and clear. Price was good and quick turn around. I can’t fault Thoroughtec and even better they are a SA family owned and operated business. Highly recommend. Thank you Adrian and family, your help and work has made us 100% solar and battery.
Installation was quick & clean.Installers were helpful & polite.All over great experience.

Prior to sending me the quotation, Adrian from Thoroughtec came to my property to discuss my needs and assess the potential installation, which I really appreciated.The quotation was professionally presented.The installation went smoothly over 2 days and the team installed all components neatly and cleaned up upon completion.Thoroughtec followed up with documentation and information, helped me to use my app and provided additional links to show how I can take advantage of my system's capacity.All in all I am very happy with how the installation has gone.

Throughout the whole process Adrian and the team at Thoroughtec Solar did a fantastic job in completing our solar system to a high standard and in a prompt manner. Adrian was very thorough in ensuring the solar panel placement presented well on our roof space. Adrian’s professionalism and communication made dealing with Thoroughtec a pleasurable and smooth experience.

Adrian listened to what my solar needs were and then quoted on a system that met all of those needs. The installation was on time and looks great. They are still in the process of having the meter changed but have been helpful all of the way and kept us informed.

Knowledgeable, uber professional, thorough in all aspects.Organised everything before and after the installation. Answered every question with good humour and patience.Very punctual, very tidy.Excellent communication as to their needs for installation and everything that would happen.Would recommend, without reservation, Adrian and his team.   Just beautiful people!!!

Thank you to the Thoroughtec team for making the installation of our new solar system so easy. This was a difficult property that no other solar company would look at for us. I contacted Thoroughtec and there were no issues or concerns from them from day 1, I'm now happily creating solar power.
Great communication throughout friendly service, fast service great quality prodect  would highly recommend

Adrian and the team at Thoroughtec Solar and Electrical were fantastic right from the start of proceedings, to the final installation.Adrian came out to my premises and completed a site inspection, taking note of shading issues on my north facing roof as well suggesting the most beneficial location of the solar inverter and the panels.Adrian was the only representative from a solar company to do this as the majority were only online quotes with google satellite views for location of the solar panels.The fact that he actually went out of his way to come out to my premises before sending a quote shows a level of consideration of the customers needs and concerns they may have.The final quote was not over priced or under priced for the equipment installed and I was given an option to use inferior equipment for a cheaper price .The installation team arrived on time and completed the whole job in about 4 and a half hours.They were courteous and answered any questions asked of them with a explanation that was clear and concise.Overall a fantastic experience and I wholeheartedly recommend them for your solar installation.

The Thoroughtec quote benefited from a site inspection as they were adding to an existing 13 year old system. The price was competitive. They provided an eficient and well managed installation.  They thought carefully about options and we ended up with the inverter in a different - and better - location.  Their staff were tidy and courteous and the handover was done well. Space was limited in the house switchboard and so they changed plan on the day and installed new switchgear in the meter box, leaving space for a EV charger connection at a later date. This change resulted in a small price reduction and a tidier overall result.  I was consulted properly about the changes.

The quoting process was excellent, very knowledgeable and explained well.Installation team arrived on time, were very polite and tidied everything.The company organised the solar connection with our electricity provider.

The sales/quoting process was very thorough and explanations provided where necessary.  The installation was extremely professional and the workers were always courteous and we were hardly aware of them working on our roof.The customer service was excellent and they arranged everything to the last tee. We were connected and operating before we realized it was comlete

Great customer service and easy to deal with. The team worked hard even though it was raining at times and completed the installation of our 10kW system in one and a half days. Without the rain, they probably would have finished in one day. The whole team were very friendly.

From the beginning the sales service/quote was thorough with Adrain personally discussing the process and benefits with us at home (not over the phone).  Any questions we had were answered promptly.Installation was quick with courteous installers - who went through the process with us.

Quick response to my initial enquiry and kept in touch regularly without being pushy. They were open to listen to what we wanted/needed and adapt to that.On the day of installation it was 35 degrees and the installation team worked until the job was done.Would highly recommend, in fact I already have.

The whole process from obtaining a quote to giving the go ahead, to completion of the installation was seamless. Staff and technicians were prompt, very polite and professional. Very pleased as the system was up and the app showing its production within 6 hrs of start of installationI’m glad I went with this company which is also a family business who certainly take pride in their quality of work and excellent service.
Thoroughtec were a great company to deal with. They provided prompt quoting and were able to install the following week. Very satisfied with our experience through them.

The team at Thoroughtec were fantastic every step of the way. Adrian was super knowledgeable & took time to explain the best system for us. Communication was exceptional, installation was seamless, tidy and of a very high standard, the whole team were very friendly & helpful.  Thoroughtec helped organise everything and answered all of our questions, including explaining how the app worked, which was fantastic. I would highly recommend Thoroughtec to anyone considering solar or electrical work!

From the quoting process Andre was a pleasure to deal with. Prompt and polite. Answered all my questions and couldn't be more helpful.On the day of the job Andre and his crew were punctual and did a great job and pretty quickly too. They tidied up afterwards and were really helpful in explaining everything.Great work
Highly recommendedGreat installation, punctual, polite, and very helpful.The system looks great.
Very polite and left our house in good order.  They arrived on time and were very helpful!

Great advice right from the enquiry stage. Install was fast and efficient and was scheduled within a week from the go ahead. The product looks good and can tell it’s good quality. Can tell from the advice given the team are experienced and know their product.

Easy and efficient solar process. Our old 1.5kw system died so we got quotes for repairs and then figured we'd quote up a new system. Adrian was helpful from the get go and happy to discuss options and our needs on the phone before coming out for a measure and quote. He gave a few options that suited our situation, and shortly after an install date was organised. A couple of weeks or so later and his team show up to do the install - they were punctual, polite, efficient and helpful.Highly recommend and really happy that we chose them for the install. Smooth process, competitive quote, and highest quality service compared to some others we got quotes from.
Quoting was quick and thorough.Installation was efficient and easy to implement.Customer service was excellent.Yes they helped with all aspects of the connection.

I had an old system which had failed and I rang around a few companies. Adrian from thoroughtec called me back, gave me advice to make the system safe and came round quickly to assess and fix the issue.  He gave me a range of options to resolve the issue and we decided that a whole new system would be the best course. The new system was bigger and fitted onto my roof perfectly.  The installation was scheduled and the team arrived on time and completed the job quickly and cleanly.  The team were extremely friendly , helpful and professional.  The area was left immaculate.  I received messages after the installation to confirm that everything was to my liking and that I was satisfied.I could not be happier with my new system and the whole team involved in fixing my problem.A first rate company
Adrian was very knowledgeable and help me understand what was best for me. The lads that installed my system were also very helpful and polite. ? ?

I couldn’t recommend this company highly enough. The professionalism and responsiveness was exceptional. I never felt pressured like I had from other company’s and felt well looked after and valued as a customer. They were prompt on installation day and the communication both pre and post install were second to none. So thankful for them!
From the first consult to the final instal, I couldn’t have been more satisfied. Professional, efficient, clean and a great team. One of the best companies to deal with. Thoroughly recommend.
The customer service was great. All the boys worked hard while keeping things tidy and looking neat. Priced well which matched the quote given. Couldn’t ask for a better outcome.

Adrian, from Thoroughtec, is an absolute gem. His dedication to tailoring a system to my specific needs was truly remarkable and gave me the confidence that I was making the right choice. The installation itself was carried out flawlessly and within the promised timeframe. The installation team demonstrated a high level of expertise and precision, leaving no room for doubt about their professionalism and skill.Since the installation, my solar system has been performing beyond my expectations, delivering significant energy savings and reducing my carbon footprint. I couldn't be happier with the results, and it's clear that this company uses top-quality materials and employs highly skilled technicians.In addition to my own satisfaction, I have personally recommended Thoroughtec to friends and family who have also chosen them for their solar needs. The feedback I've received from those I've referred has been nothing but positive, further validating my trust in this company.If you're in the market for a solar system installation and want a company that is professional, personable, and committed to delivering a tailored solution, look no further. I wholeheartedly endorse, Thoroughtec and their team, they have earned my highest recommendation. I am confident they will do the same for anyone fortunate enough to choose their services.
The whole process was easy and simple.The company was great to work with.The installers was easy going and the price was competitive.I've had the system for a while now and had no issues to date.

I recently had the pleasure of working with Thoroughtec and I am happy to share my positive experience. From start to finish, their service has met or exceeded my expectations in every aspect.The installation process was completed much quicker than I anticipated, without compromising on quality. The team was very well prepared and finished the whole job (10.5kW system, single inverter) in less than a day. The panels, wiring and the inverter were all expertly installed with attention to detail. All cracked/broken tiles were replaced free of charge and the roof was carefully inspected afterwards. I have confidence that the system will operate flawlessly for years to come.Throughout the entire project, the communication from Thoroughtec was superb. Adrian was consistently responsive, keeping me informed at every step of the process. Their transparency and willingness to address my questions and concerns demonstrated their commitment to customer satisfaction.I was very impressed by the valuable advice and guidance I received from Adrian and Andre. They took the time to assess my specific needs and provided insightful recommendations to optimize my solar setup. They also put my existing hot water system on a timer, reducing future water heating bills.In conclusion, great service! After having less fortune with some other tradespeople in the past, I can say that Thoroughtec have set a benchmark for professionalism, efficiency, and expertise in the trades industry. Highly recommended.Thank you, Adrian, Andre, Sophia, and the rest of the team, for making this a seamless and rewarding experience.

We had plenty of quotes before we decided to have solar installed. From the moment we first spoke with Adrian from Thoroughtec solar and electrical we knew we were in capable hands. His professional and down to earth nature convinced us they were perfect for the job. They weren't the cheapest quote we had, but the old saying goes you get what you pay for. Couldn't be happier with the install, as a tradie myself I have pretty high standards. Andre and his team did an amazing job, kept us informed during the entire process. I would have no hesitation in recommending Thoroughtec Solar and Electrical for any works you may require.Thanks again teamSteve and Allison

The quote was a very easy process through their sales manager, very polite, very knowledgeable and no nonsense.I had the installation done on a residential rental property, the team at Thoroughtech liaised with my property manager and the tenants to ensure a very smooth and punctual install.Excellent customer service, again very streamlined, no messing around from quote to install. As at completion I was provided a mobile application to show the current energy production, consumption and grid drawdown to track the systems performance.100% will use them again on future projects.
Great service. Adrian was very professional and did a great job and upgraded our switchboard as well

The whole installation was completed in just under 1 day. Adrian was very helpful and had the time to answer every question I had before and during the installation. After doing my homework on solar systems Adrian was consistent with what I have read on solar beforehand. Workmanship was very professional, too the book.
